arms.failure_reason: RuntimeError: AgentV SDK is unavailable; run npm ci in the checkout or set AGENTV_RUNNER
RuntimeError: AgentV SDK is unavailable; run npm ci in the checkout or set AGENTV_RUNNER

harness_repair.diagnosis: This sandbox's checkout is freshly cloned each session; npm ci had never been run at the repo root or in either bridge subdir, so node_modules/@agentv/core did not exist and evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crashed in publish_model_evaluation before producing a scoreboard for either arm. This is the same failure class already documented for cycle c2 on 2026-08-03 (docs/design/autotrain-cycle-c2-agentv-missing-infra-failure.md); the fix committed then (scripts/setup_dev_env.sh running npm ci, and bridge_utils.sanitized_node_env() wired into lang_core.py and evals/agentv.py) did not prevent a *later* fresh container from hitting the identical bare-checkout gap, because nothing in the continuous driver enforced the SDK precondition before starting a cycle. Investigating the same gap surfaced a second, independent bug: src/slm_training/dsl/design_md/__init__.py's node bridge (DESIGN.md lint, used by build_train_data's default-DESIGN.md attachment) never adopted sanitized_node_env() when the sibling lang_core/graphql-js/agentv bridges did, so a host NODE_OPTIONS value this Node build rejects (--import tsx) broke it silently (8 tests failing in tests/test_scripts/test_build_train_data_cli.py, tests/test_scripts/test_slm_cli.py before the fix).
harness_repair.fix_summary: Added scripts.run_autotrain_continuous._require_agentv_sdk_available as a cycle-start preflight (called from run_cycle right after the clean-tree check) so a missing AgentV SDK fails in under a second instead of after training already spent its wall budget. Brought src/slm_training/dsl/design_md/__init__.py's node subprocess spawns (REPL and one-shot invoke) in line with the lang_core/graphql-js/agentv bridges by using bridge_utils.sanitized_node_env() instead of a raw os.environ.copy(). Environment setup itself (npm ci at repo root, src/apps/openui_bridge, src/apps/design_md_bridge) was re-run per scripts/setup_dev_env.sh / README Quick start for this session's fresh checkout; that step is not new code, it is the documented precondition the preflight now enforces automatically.
